description.value: Pacific Shores Resort & Spa is a thirteen-acre waterfront resort set alongside Craig Bay near Nanoose Bay on Vancouver Island, offering suite-style accommodations with full kitchens and in-suite washer/dryers. The property includes indoor and outdoor pools, hot tubs, a wellness spa, on-site physiotherapy, and 10 pickleball courts. Seasonal guest use of cruiser bikes, kayaks, and stand-up paddle boards makes it a comfortable base for exploring the Parksville-Qualicum corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and provides detailed amenity information. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed via 'Our daily resort fee includes wifi' on the amenities page, and in-suite laundry is confirmed via 'All comes with washer/dryer' in the room descriptions. No secure bike storage for guests' own bikes is mentioned anywhere on the site — the resort offers cruiser bikes for guest loan but says nothing about storing touring bikes — so both required criteria are null. The on-site restaurant is noted as 'closed until further notice', which is worth flagging but does not affect the resort's operational status.
concerns: On-site restaurant is closed until further notice per the /about subpage — cyclists should not count on dining on-site.
OSM email (guestservices@pacificshoresbc.com) differs from the website header primary email (gm@pacificshoresbc.com); both addresses appear on the website so this is a minor discrepancy only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly bookable waterfront resort with a functioning website, confirmed address, and a broad range of amenities useful to touring cyclists stopping in the Nanoose Bay area.

Laundry.detail: In-suite washer/dryer included in all room types per room description page: 'All comes with washer/dryer'

Wi-Fi.detail: Included in daily resort fee per amenities page: 'Our daily resort fee includes wifi, parking, arrival bottled water, in-room tea and coffee'

wow_evidence: indoor and outdoor pools, hot tubs, a wellness spa, on-site physiotherapy

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: 13-acre waterfront spa resort, full suites with kitchens; $220-320
